method: Unmodified original Collision2DSystem and QuadTree, actual original Circle/Rectangle and bundled THREE in Chromium. RAF held, scene entry suppressed. Plain collidable objects use explicit unique UUID strings, shape/position/registration/bounds/limit inputs; every registered handler only records directed notifications. No callbacks mutate registration/bounds mid-pass. This verifies measured contact order, dynamic clears, surviving quad topology and add/remove/readd/bounds-reset behavior; actor pooling, concrete handler actions and debug rendering are not certified.
